name: verify_colored_object_grasp
summary: Verify a parallel-jaw test lift of a color-grounded rigid object using independent visual and gripper evidence.

generality.rationale: The physical checks transfer to many table-top rigid objects, but the current implementation depends on color relocalization, a support-plane lift, and parallel-jaw aperture semantics.
assumptions: The target can be relocalized by a supported dominant color after the lift.
A successful grasp raises the target away from its original support.
The gripper reports aperture in meters and a nonempty grasp does not fully close.
limitations: Not suitable for suction, pushing, in-hand occlusion, transparent targets, or deformable objects.
A thin successfully grasped object may look like an empty fully closed gripper.
All checks currently use one post-action snapshot instead of a synchronized temporal track.

level.rationale: It composes target relocalization, support displacement, TCP proximity, lateral displacement, visibility, and gripper state into a strict grasp verdict.

composition.strategy: Reobserve the target and combine independent geometric and gripper predicates; all predicates must currently pass.

provenance.failure_gap: The learner declared grasp success after an arm motion without independent evidence that the object was held.
